newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares continue slide, volatility seen.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares continue slide, volatility seen.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.75 percent on Wednesday on continued uncertainty and market participants said they expected the market to fluctuate over the next few weeks.
"I think we will have to have strong nerves as the market will be volatile in the short term," Davor Dubokovic, a trader at Eastbrokers, said.
* The SBI index fell 10.79 points to 1,430.3.
* Overall five shares fell, eight rose, one was unchanged, while 11 were untraded.
* Bank SKB was the most active, firming 5.17 percent to 61,000 tolars on volume of 2,353 shares.
